footprint_drawing.pad_size: 0.25 x 0.275 on the package; land = +25 um per side (p69)
footprint_drawing.layout: top view: pins 1,2 on the top edge, 3,4,5 down the right edge, 6,7 on the bottom edge (6 right, 7 left), 8,9,10 up the left edge; opposite rows 1.525 apart centre to centre
footprint_drawing.rules: no vias or traces under the part, no solder mask under it, >=0.2 mm between pads (p69)
footprint_drawing.kicad_near_miss: Package_LGA:ST_HLGA-10_2x2mm_P0.5mm_LayoutBorder3x2y has the same pad grid turned 90 degrees but a different pin order: make a new footprint

logic: levels follow VDDIO; 3.3 V bus direct

i2c_addr.select: SDO pin: GND 0x46, VDDIO 0x47; must not float (p38)

expander: BARO_INT (optional data-ready; else tie pin 7 to GND and keep int_en off, p46)

placement: Port hole in the lid: shared vent, any side of the board that sees outside air.
For infrasound keep it out of the airflow path of the microphone holes and away from parts that pulse heat (converter inductors, front light).
Light can reach the die through the port: do not put it under the clear window.
notes: Infrasound use: continuous mode up to 489 Hz with pressure and temperature (p12).
unverified: Pad numbering on the footprint: taken from the top-view figure p46; the dimensioned bottom view on p68 is drawn turned, so check pin 1 against the drawing.
